newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Management Systems.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Management Systems.

text.p: -- Stephens Inc said it downgraded American Management Systems Inc to buy from strong buy.
-- cited uncertainty about the status of a contract and concerns that consensus expectations for 1997 are too high.
-- the company told analysts it expects to resolve the contract problem by the end of March, Stephens Inc said.
-- Stephens cut the 12-month price target to $25 a share from $30.
-- American Management dropped 3-11/16 to 18-5/16 in afternoon trading.
-- Earlier on Thursday, American Management posted fourth quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, compared with $0.25 a share last year.
